definitions.explanation: Pollock or cod roe marinated in chili pepper and other seasonings. A specialty of Fukuoka (Hakata) and one of Japan's most popular rice accompaniments and onigiri fillings. The unseasoned version is called たらこ.

notes:
USAGE:
{明太子|めんたいこ} specifically refers to spicy seasoned pollock roe. The unseasoned version is ⟦たらこ→たらこ：15258_tarako⟧ ({鱈子|たらこ}). The name comes from Korean: {明太|めんたい} is the Korean word for pollock (명태), and ⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ means roe. {博多|はかた} (⟦{福岡|ふくおか}→福岡：30729_fukuoka⟧) is credited with popularizing the modern spicy version.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {明太子|めんたいこ}⟦おにぎり→おにぎり：04956_onigiri⟧: mentaiko rice ball
- {明太子|めんたいこ}⟦パスタ→パスタ：06768_pasuta⟧: mentaiko pasta
- {辛子|からし}{明太子|めんたいこ}: spicy mentaiko (formal/full name)
- {博多|はかた}{明太子|めんたいこ}: Hakata mentaiko (brand origin)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦たらこ→たらこ：15258_tarako⟧: unseasoned pollock roe (plain, salted)
- {明太子|めんたいこ}: spicy seasoned pollock roe (chili-marinated)
